finding: The composition (four segments, fixed order, per-segment boundary sentences) has two artifacts that each declare themselves its sole owner. The contract header names `templates/commands/review.md` § Composition as owner of the composition, the order and the boundaries; T002 and § Notes name `shared/workflow/acceptance-hardening.md` § Review Composition as the only definition point for six items that include the four segments, the fixed order and the boundary sentences. T002's sibling row T007 then requires the command template to declare the same four segments plus five per-segment fields. FR-013 mandates both halves (the command must declare segments, order and boundaries; the derivation rule belongs to the owner doc), so T002's sole-ownership claim and FR-013/T007 cannot both hold. § Notes forbids only a second statement of the derivation rule, so the six items it appears to protect are in fact covered by the prohibition for one of them only. This is Principle XIV (One Source of Truth) broken at the level of the fact that defines the whole slice.
evidence: contracts/review-composition.contract.md:4 'Owner of the composition, the order and the boundaries: templates/commands/review.md § Composition (the owner text this feature rewrites)'. tasks.md:92 'Land ## Review Composition … as the **only** definition point' followed by 'the four segments in the fixed order … the per-segment boundary sentences'. tasks.md:264 'the four segments, the fixed order, the ARC clauses … are defined in shared/workflow/acceptance-hardening.md § Review Composition'. requirements.md:153 'MUST 在该 owner 内把它改写为四段加一次确定性判定、固定顺序 … 并逐段声明判定对象与职责边界'. tasks.md:115 (T007 rewrites ## Composition and ## Delegation to the same four segments). shared/workflow/acceptance-hardening.md § Extension Points (line 449+) still lists the 081c bullet, so the section is not yet on disk and the conflict is unadjudicated rather than resolved in fact.
recommendation: Split the fact by layer and say so once. Owner doc § Review Composition owns the content (segments, order, boundary sentences, derivation rule, ARC clause, census); templates/commands/review.md § Composition owns the command-side declaration that FR-013 requires (four headings plus the five fields, by anchor). Then rewrite contract line 4 to name the command-side declaration rather than the composition, and rewrite T002 so it no longer claims sole ownership of the items T007 must also declare. This is a decision between two readings and needs an owner ruling; it MUST NOT be repaired in passing.

finding: SC-002 is recorded as the criterion this slice is expected to move to `pass`, but its second leg (Planned → Implemented → Ready for Review with zero false refusals, 2/2) has no reachable input. The review-site fourth condition is judged only when the claimed status is `Implemented` or `Ready for Review` (RC-15, data-model V-12), and the only clean fixture, `positive`, claims `Planned`: driving it at the review site yields 'condition not applicable', which is a vacuous pass, not a measurement. The single fixture claiming `Implemented` (`smoke-mutation`) is the one that must be refused. So a slice can honestly record 'the positive path was re-driven at that site' and still have measured nothing about the R4R leg.
evidence: Live read-only run in this analysis: `python3 scripts/python/closure-acceptance-check.py --spec-dir tests/fixtures/acceptance-hardening/positive --json` → verdict accept, claimed_status Planned, final_path {pass:1,total:1}. Same command on `smoke-mutation` → verdict block, claimed_status Implemented, reasons [status-claims-implemented-but-blocked]. data-model.md:81 V-12 ('fires only when the claimed status is Implemented or Ready for Review'). tasks.md:229 ('SC-002 … expected **pass**'). tasks.md:130 (T013: pass only with a recorded review-site measurement). requirements.md:204 SC-002 '全程 accept，误拒 0（2/2）'.
recommendation: Either add the fixture shape SC-002 actually needs (claimed `Implemented`, all final-path SCs `pass`, complete smoke record, expected to be accepted at the review site), or demote the `## Slice Boundary` expectation from `pass` to `partial` and make T013's fallback the plan rather than the exception. Whatever is chosen, forbid recording a `positive`-on-`Planned` run as the measurement — it passes by inapplicability, which is exactly the class of overstatement this feature exists to catch.

finding: SC-006 requires that a negative fixture produce the fixed item F-ACCEPTANCE at P0 and refuse the transition; RC-15's trigger is 'claimed status is Implemented or Ready for Review AND the pass bucket is zero'. No fixture in the corpus satisfies both conjuncts: `negative` has pass=0 but claims `Planned`; `smoke-mutation` claims `Implemented` but has pass=1, so it refuses for a different reason (status-claims-implemented-but-blocked) and cannot emit F-ACCEPTANCE. T004 leg (f) and GATE-7 both name `negative`, and § Notes asserts that the two existing fixtures already answer the question, so the F-ACCEPTANCE half of SC-006 has neither a fixture nor a leg that can go red. The checklist named `smoke-mutation` as the reachable one; that is wrong for this condition, which makes the gap larger than reported rather than smaller.

finding: The shape written into `review.md` has two spellings with different countable readings. FR-015 requires three counts (pass/blocked/deferred) in review.md; RC-14 requires the seven-key `final_path` record verbatim and forbids narrowing it to a three-count summary; SC-006's acceptance reading is 'the three counts are present, 3/3'. A report that writes only the three counts satisfies SC-006 and violates RC-14, and a report that writes the seven keys satisfies both — so the acceptance criterion cannot distinguish the form the contract forbids. T013 re-describes SC-006 as 'the copied seven-field record', which is neither SC-006's text nor an amendment of it.

finding: FR-013 states an unconditional MUST that every finding carries a severity and a 'artifact path + line' locator. The contract weakens it to 'a path (+ line where the finding is line-anchored)', the plan writes 'optional line', and the data model writes `line (optional)`. No leg asserts the locator at all: leg (g) checks only that the slot and its placeholders exist. SC-006's 'each finding carries path + line (sampling L/L)' therefore has no object to sample from, because the field it samples was downgraded to optional in three artifacts while the requirement still says MUST.
evidence: requirements.md:153 ('每条 finding MUST 带严重度与「产物路径 + 行号」定位'). contracts/review-composition.contract.md:16 ('a severity and a `path` (+ `line` where the finding is line-anchored)'). plan.md:289 ('finding form = severity + artifact/implementation path + optional line'). data-model.md:175 ('`line` (optional)'). requirements.md:208 SC-006 ('每条 finding 带严重度与「产物路径 + 行号」（抽样 L/L）'). tasks.md:109 legs (a)-(i), none of which asserts the locator.

Then add a leg that asserts the `### 2.2` finding-location field set. If the weaker form is intended, amend FR-013 and SC-006 deliberately — a contract MUST NOT quietly drop a requirement's MUST.

finding: RC-03's and DoD-3's 'MUST NOT survive anywhere' has no scope. Measured today the phrase lives in 23 markdown files: the framework template, the docs page, four per-tool copies, the regenerated mirrors' source, dated records in specs 071 and 080, this feature's own specification text, and the installed copy under `.venv/lib/python3.14/site-packages/specify_cli/templates/commands/review.md` — which no row in this slice regenerates. Read literally the MUST is unsatisfiable; read loosely it is unfalsifiable. (The checklist counted 20 files; the measured count is 23, including two `.specify/.tmp/` briefs and this feature's own artifacts.)

Includes `.venv/lib/python3.14/site-packages/specify_cli/templates/commands/review.md` and dated records under `.specify/specs/071-review-code-integration/` and `.specify/specs/080-humanize-run-output/`. contracts/review-composition.contract.md:10 (RC-03), tasks.md:29 (DoD-3), tasks.md:109 (leg (a) asserts only the command template).
recommendation: Give RC-03/DoD-3 a closed scope (framework source + the four per-tool copies + the regenerated mirrors) and a stated exclusion list (dated spec records, the installed site-packages copy), and make leg (a) assert exactly that scope. An unbounded 'nowhere' will be resolved by whoever writes the test, and their reading will become the requirement.

finding: The derivation rule names its input as the slice's stage rules plus `plan.md` § Project Structure, and then enumerates seven members that are not the product of that input. Plan § Documentation lists ten items — plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, quickstart.md, contracts/, feature-ref.md, baseline-failed.txt, test-evidence/, tasks.md, verification.md — and does not list requirements.md, which is one of the seven. So the rule read literally yields ten members (including four that are evidence or scaffolding), and read practically reduces to the hard-coded seven. Neither reading is owned, and the difference decides what the coverage denominator is.
evidence: contracts/review-composition.contract.md:16 (input plus seven members). plan.md:125-137 (§ Documentation block, ten items, requirements.md absent). requirements.md:153 (the same seven). tasks.md:31 (DoD-5), tasks.md:109 leg (d).
recommendation: State which list is authoritative and how a member is derived: name the subsection the rule derives from, and say whether a directory member (`contracts/`) counts as one member or as its files. If the seven are intended, say they override the derivation for this feature, and record why research.md and feature-ref.md are excluded.
